name: Domain Password Policy Enumeration
description: Retrieve the domain password policy (lockout threshold, observation window, minimum length) via null SMB session — no credentials needed.
notes: Know lockout threshold BEFORE spraying. Stay at least 2 attempts below threshold per observation window.

defense.why_it_works: Domain password policy (lockout threshold, observation window, min length) is accessible to any authenticated user via LDAP (objectClass=domain). Attackers query this before spraying to calibrate attempt rate and stay under the lockout threshold.
defense.prerequisites: Any valid domain account. LDAP access to DC. PowerView, AD Module, or `net accounts /domain`.
defense.impact: T1201 Password Policy Discovery. Reveals lockout threshold and window, enabling precisely calibrated password sprays that avoid lockouts. Weak policy (no lockout, short passwords) directly enables brute force.
defense.detection:
LDAP query for domain password policy attributes is low signal — indistinguishable from legitimate admin activity. MDI can baseline and flag unusual queriers. Downstream detection: password spray via Event 4625/4771 patterns is more reliable.
Shell/PowerShell queries of local/domain password policy via net accounts, Get-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy, secedit /export; optional directory/LDAP reads from DCs; adjacent Discovery or credential-related actions within a short window (DET0161/AN0455). Linux: chage -l, grep/cat of PAM config (/etc/pam.d/common-password, /etc/security/pwquality.conf), /etc/login.defs reads, followed by account enumeration or password change attempts (AN0456). macOS: pwpolicy or MDM/DirectoryService reads, /Library/Preferences/com.apple.loginwindow, followed by credential probing (AN0457). Cloud: AWS GetAccountPasswordPolicy or equivalent API calls followed by user creation, credential rotation, or auth setting changes (AN0458). IdP: policy/read operations followed by risky changes like role assignment or app consent (AN0459). SaaS: Get-MsolPasswordPolicy or similar admin cmdlets followed by mailbox/tenant changes (AN0460). Network devices: show aaa, show password-policy followed by AAA/user DB changes (AN0461).
defense.artifacts: LDAP diagnostic log (if enabled): search for objectClass=domain | MDI alert: downstream spray activity | SIEM: 4625 lockout pattern from single source
defense.prevention:
Strong password policy: min 14 chars, lockout at 5 attempts, 30-min observation window. Fine-Grained Password Policy (PSO) for DA accounts with stricter settings. Azure AD Password Protection. MFA enforcement.
Password Policies: Ensure only valid password filters are registered. Filter DLLs must be in C:\Windows\System32\ with a corresponding entry in HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa\Notification Packages.
defense.evasion: Single LDAP query — no volume, no anomaly. Indistinguishable from legitimate queries.
defense.misconfiguration: LockoutThreshold = 0 (no lockout) — unlimited spray attempts possible. Minimum password length 8. No Fine-Grained Policy for admins. No MFA.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# Check domain password policy:
Get-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy
# LockoutThreshold : 0  ← CRITICAL — unlimited attempts
# MinPasswordLength : 8  ← too short
# ComplexityEnabled : True  ← satisfied by P@ssw0rd
defense.secure_config:
# Set strong domain password policy:
Set-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy -Identity corp.local `
  -MinPasswordLength 14 `
  -LockoutThreshold 5 `
  -LockoutObservationWindow (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 30) `
  -LockoutDuration (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 30) `
  -ComplexityEnabled $true

# Fine-Grained PSO for Domain Admins:
New-ADFineGrainedPasswordPolicy -Name 'PSO-DA' -Precedence 1 -MinPasswordLength 20 -LockoutThreshold 3 -LockoutObservationWindow (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 60) -LockoutDuration (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 0)
Add-ADFineGrainedPasswordPolicySubject 'PSO-DA' -Subjects 'Domain Admins'
